HERO-011.orig: A Sacred Trek Across the Himalayas to Muktinath

LETTER-002.orig: In 2022 we walked in the Himalaya with a group of soul seekers from all around the world, and we felt it clearly: the mountains themselves are a sacred medicine. We are going back to receive a message, guidance and the blessings of the Himalayas. We warmly invite you to come with us on this journey, one that can touch you deeply in heart, mind and soul.

LETTER-003.orig: In spring 2027 we will walk the Annapurna Circuit together, from Pokhara over the Thorong La pass to Muktinath, a holy place that pilgrims have walked to for centuries. The route winds through the sacred peaks of Annapurna, the Goddess of Abundance. It is a fourteen-day program with nine days of walking. We go as a small group with a mountain guide and porters, and there is time every day for prayer, singing, sharing and deep inner listening.

LETTER-004.orig: Spring is a beautiful time to walk here. The hillsides glow with rhododendrons, the national flower of Nepal, and the snow peaks stand sharp and bright against a deep blue sky. The days are warm in the sun, the nights are cold and quiet, and the high ridges still wear their winter snow.

LETTER-005.orig: Muktinath is sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, and its name is often translated as ‘Lord of Liberation’. Water from 108 springs pours from the rock, a small flame burns beside the water, and all five elements are said to meet in this one place.

LETTER-006.orig: A golden seated statue under a richly painted canopy, with prayer wheels and snow mountains behind

LETTER-007.orig: A pilgrimage is simply a walk with a purpose.

LETTER-008.orig: Some people come with a question. Some come to put something heavy down. Some just love the mountains and want to share them with kind company. All of that is welcome, and you do not need to follow any particular tradition to join us.

ROUTE-002.orig: Annapurna Circuit and Tilicho Lake. We start in Pokhara, drive into the mountains, walk over the Thorong La pass and arrive in Muktinath.

ROUTE-003.orig: Sketch map of the route from Pokhara through Chame, Manang and Tilicho Lake, over Thorong La to Muktinath

ROUTE-016.orig: Overnight altitude by day, rising from 820 m in Pokhara to 4,600 m at Thorong Phedi, with the pass at 5,416 m on day 12, then back down

ROUTE-021.orig: Arrive in Pokhara and check in at the hotel in your own time. Overnight at the hotel.

ROUTE-023.orig: Group introductions, an opening talk and a safety briefing. Gear shopping and renting, permits and paperwork. Sharing circle. Overnight at the hotel.

ROUTE-026.orig: Our journey begins. A day of driving on mountain roads. In the evening we soak in the hot springs of Chame, then hold our opening circle with intention setting, meditation and prayer.

ROUTE-029.orig: Walking through forest, with views of Annapurna II.

ROUTE-032.orig: The upper trail, with wide views of the whole Annapurna range.

ROUTE-035.orig: A hike above the village to help the body adjust, then back to Manang for the night.

ROUTE-044.orig: A morning climb to one of the highest lakes in the world. Overnight in Shri Kharka (~4,080 m).

ROUTE-047.orig: Little altitude gain. Walking toward the pass.

ROUTE-050.orig: Our last camp before the pass. Rest and preparation.

ROUTE-053.orig: The crossing of the pass, the highest and fullest day of the journey. We sleep in Muktinath (~3,800 m), and the high-altitude banya (Russian sauna) is waiting.

ROUTE-056.orig: The Muktinath temple, sacred to Hindus and Buddhists, the 108 springs, and the Gumba Samba and Jwala Mai temples. We rest, share, and close our circle with prayer.

ROUTE-059.orig: Back by jeep via Jomsom, or by a short flight. Those joining Shamanic Immersion stay in Muktinath.

DAYS-003.orig: Gentle movement and breathing to wake up the body for the day of walking.

DAYS-005.orig: At your own rhythm, sometimes talking, sometimes in silence.

DAYS-007.orig: At special places along the trail we pause for short moments of ritual, prayer and meditation, to arrive in the place and listen inside.

DAYS-009.orig: At the start, each person sets an intention. It can be a question, a wish or a prayer. We return to it on the pass and again in Muktinath.

DAYS-011.orig: Kirtan and mantra, song circles, heart songs and medicine songs. We both sing, on our own and together, and you are invited to sing with us.

DAYS-013.orig: Every evening we gather to listen to each other and share from the heart.

IMMERSION-003.orig: A snow-covered Himalayan peak above a mountain road

IMMERSION-004.orig: After crossing Thorong La, the body has accomplished a great deal, and the mind often becomes quieter and more open. For those who feel called to continue the journey more deeply, we stay in Muktinath for six more days.

IMMERSION-005.orig: The pace slows down, giving us space to rest, integrate the experience of the mountains, and turn inward. Our days include meditation and silence, energy and body practices, intention work, and two plant medicine ceremonies guided by Yakov.

IMMERSION-006.orig: Between practices, there is time to recover, share experiences, and simply be together. This is an opportunity to deepen your connection with yourself, listen more closely to what is unfolding within, and allow the journey to settle into your life.

IMMERSION-007.orig: A Place to Rest and Restore

IMMERSION-008.orig: Throughout the six-day immersion, we stay in a comfortable hotel in Muktinath, with good food, hot showers, a dedicated ceremony hall, and a traditional Russian sauna at high altitude.

IMMERSION-009.orig: The setting allows us to step away from the demands of the trail, restore our energy, and give the inner journey the time and attention it deserves.

IMMERSION-013.orig: A gentle day to recover after the trek, settle into Muktinath, and reconnect with the intention that brought us here.

IMMERSION-016.orig: A guided plant medicine ceremony held in a safe, supportive setting, with space for inner exploration and reflection.

IMMERSION-019.orig: Time to share experiences, integrate what has unfolded, rest, and enjoy the traditional Russian sauna at high altitude.

IMMERSION-022.orig: A daytime ceremony with San Pedro in the Himalayan mountains, offering space for reflection, connection with nature, and inner exploration.

IMMERSION-025.orig: A day for sharing, integration, rest, and our closing circle, bringing the journey together before departure.

IMMERSION-028.orig: A jeep transfer from Muktinath to Pokhara is included in Shamanic Immersion.

GUIDES-002.orig: Yakov Rajuna sitting with a frame drum

GUIDES-010.orig: Yakov is a healer, musician, and spiritual guide who helps people reconnect with themselves, find inner balance, and rediscover their true nature.

GUIDES-011.orig: For over ten years, he has been holding plant medicine ceremonies, learning from shamanic traditions in Peru and Brazil, and exploring the wisdom of non-duality.

GUIDES-012.orig: Through meditation, Qi Gong, music, and energy work, he creates a space for deep inner exploration, healing, and transformation.

GUIDES-013.orig: His intention is simple: to help people open their hearts, reconnect with life, and find their way back to themselves.

GUIDES-014.orig: Akari Tamura playing guitar under a tree

GUIDES-018.orig: Teacher of voice, instrument and devotional living

GUIDES-019.orig: Akari began classical piano at a very young age, plays several instruments, and has made music all her life. Since 2006 she has been studying yoga, spirituality and Bhakti, and she has been teaching since 2013. She has guided thousands of people around the world through concerts, workshops, retreats and trainings in Bali, Thailand, Japan, India and Europe, sharing kirtan, mantra, yoga and the practice of devotion. She is passionate about creating transformative experiences that help each of us realize our connection with the divine center. In 2022 she and Yakov created and walked a trekking retreat to Mardi Himal. On this pilgrimage she brings kirtan, mantra, music and prayer to the trail and evening circles.

SAFETY-002.orig: The route is led by a professional mountain guide with long experience on high-altitude Himalayan treks. Everything is planned in advance, and our team takes care of the details. Once you sign up, we will send you the full list of what to bring and all the information you need to make this journey safe.

SAFETY-004.orig: A professional mountain guide. ACAP and TIMS permits are arranged in advance by the organizers.

SAFETY-006.orig: Porters carry your main bags for the entire trek. You carry only what you need for the day.

SAFETY-008.orig: A first-aid kit with altitude medication, including for altitude sickness, stays with the guide.

SAFETY-010.orig: A rest day in Manang and a gradual gain in height, with a helicopter emergency plan along the route.

SAFETY-012.orig: Medical insurance covering helicopter evacuation up to 6,000 m (paid separately, about $100)

SAFETY-013.orig: Normal or good physical condition and readiness for multi-day trekking

SAFETY-014.orig: A short video call with us before you join

SAFETY-015.orig: A trekker holding a flag on a snow peak

SAFETY-016.orig: A person standing on rocks with arms open, facing snow mountains

PRICE-013.orig: Accommodation is included in every price

PRICE-014.orig: Every night of the program is covered: hotels in Pokhara and Muktinath, and lodges along the trek.

PRICE-016.orig: Trekking guide and porters for the entire route

PRICE-019.orig: Transfer from Muktinath to Pokhara for main program participants

PRICE-021.orig: 2 nights with breakfast in Pokhara and 2 nights with breakfast in Muktinath

PRICE-023.orig: Shamanic Immersion: 6 nights with breakfast in a comfortable hotel

PRICE-024.orig: Shamanic Immersion: jeep from Muktinath to Pokhara on April 16

PRICE-029.orig: Short moments of ritual, prayer and meditation on the trail

PRICE-031.orig: Shamanic Immersion: 2 plant medicine ceremonies (Ayahuasca and San Pedro), meditation and silence, energy and body practices, integration

PRICE-033.orig: $100 off for every person who joins on your recommendation, while places are available.

NOTINC-002.orig: International flights to and from Nepal, to Pokhara or Kathmandu

NOTINC-003.orig: Your own way to Pokhara, by plane, jeep or bus

NOTINC-004.orig: Optional flight from Jomsom to Pokhara (about $100)

NOTINC-005.orig: Nepal visa for 30 days, US$50. We recommend applying online before you arrive

NOTINC-007.orig: Meals, about $15 to 30 a day, except four breakfasts included in the main program and six breakfasts in Shamanic Immersion. All other meals are paid by each participant

NOTINC-008.orig: Personal expenses, such as drinking water and showers

NOTINC-009.orig: Trekking gear, such as proper clothing, shoes and poles. All of it can be rented in Pokhara

NOTINC-010.orig: Two 3x4 photos are also needed for the permits. We suggest arriving in Pokhara or Kathmandu one or two days before March 28.

NOTINC-011.orig: If You’re Joining Shamanic Immersion Only

NOTINC-012.orig: You’ll need to arrange your own journey from Pokhara to Muktinath. Depending on availability, you can travel by bus, jeep, or plane. Our team will be happy to help you plan your route and arrange the most suitable transport.

NOTINC-013.orig: April 16: A jeep transfer from Muktinath to Pokhara is included in the Shamanic Immersion price.

JOIN-002.orig: A group of up to 15 people

JOIN-003.orig: Good physical fitness is needed, since the route asks for endurance even with porter support

JOIN-004.orig: We would love to meet you on a short video call before you join

JOIN-005.orig: Once you sign up, we will tell you exactly what to bring and prepare

JOIN-006.orig: To join, fill in the registration form.

JOIN-007.orig: It takes about 10 minutes and is not a final booking. We will write to you to arrange a short video call.

JOIN-009.orig: Questions first? Write to one of us.

CLOSING-001.orig: We are so looking forward to journeying together and creating a once in a lifetime memory. In 2022 we walked to Mardi Himal as a group, and many of our friends told us afterwards that their lives truly changed. It is a priceless experience to share, and we are so happy to begin it with you. We look forward to each soul coming together in divine alignment and arrangement.

CLOSING-003.orig: Annapurna Pilgrimage, Nepal, March to April 2027
